rules.rationale: Alternate concise explanation with concentrated proof so hierarchy remains legible.
allowed: one sparse explanation region before a dense proof region

rules.rationale: Numbers and labels must describe a nearby object, event or outcome.
allowed: data labels connected by proximity, caption or leader

rules.rationale: One primary visual subject anchors each proof-bearing surface.
allowed: object, photograph, diagram or typographic statement as protagonist

rules.rationale: Boundaries and alignment communicate measurable relationships without prescribing a source motif.
allowed: offset frame, ruled field, baseline bracket, calibrated gap
forbidden: mandatory viewport rails or fixed cut-corner measurements

rules.rationale: Visual detail must improve comprehension or proof.
allowed: evidence-bearing image, label, comparison or sequence

rules.rationale: Prefer direct surfaces and explicit relationships over stacked generic cards.
allowed: flat proof canvas with subordinate callouts

rules.rationale: A small signal budget keeps evidence and action distinguishable.
allowed: one primary and one supporting signal per surface
forbidden: three or more simultaneous accent families

rules.rationale: Narrative sequence adapts density and type size to viewing distance and progression.
allowed: cover, problem, insight, mechanism, evidence, use case, result, CTA
forbidden: same layout duplicated across all pages
